title: Set up the Matt Pocock skills yourself
caption: Five lines in an empty folder of your own. Skip the starter zip: it would bring the Matt Pocock skills a second time.

rows.label: Five lines to set up the Matt Pocock skills yourself

node.title: Install Node.js
node.reason: The skills installer runs on it. Take the version the page recommends.

add.title: Add the main Matt Pocock skills
add.reason: In your terminal. When it asks which skills, keep the main group and leave Other unticked.

setup.title: Run his setup skill in your AI agent
setup.reason: It asks a few questions, one at a time. Give these four answers.

check.title: Add our check and the hancrafted entry
check.reason: The only two pieces from us. Unzip the skill into the skills folder the installer made; paste the entry into GLOSSARY.md, or create the file with it.

run.title: Run the same check as step 7
run.reason: It confirms the Matt Pocock skills are in place. Approve its command, and the hancrafted homepage opens.

picker.question: ? Which skills do you want to install?
picker.main: main group, with the setup skill

same-chain-built-by-hand.title: Same chain, built by hand
same-chain-built-by-hand.script: What the starter folder did for you comes down to four short steps. You install Node.js from its official page, add the Matt Pocock skills, run his setup skill so everything stays local without a GitHub account, and then run the check. The exact lines are on the page, because I would rather you copy them from there than hear them from me.

same-proof.title: Same proof
same-proof.script: The proof is the same as before. You run check-workshop-readiness, and the hancrafted homepage opens. One thing to know: that skill comes with the starter folder, not with the Matt Pocock skills, so the page tells you where to take it from.
